title: Adaptive calibration run for enterprise accuracy assessment (customer request)
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Summary: A high-profile enterprise customer on Redwood Private has requested an exception to our default quantization policy: they want an FP8 deployment for a latency-sensitive service but need a bespoke calibration and accuracy validation run before we enable the profile on their Dedicated pool. This ticket coordinates the calibration run, accuracy gates, and deliverables for the support engagement.

Background: The customer's workload contains long-tail conversational prompts and a financial-domain instruction set. Standard automated calibration produced a measurable semantic regression on a set of domain prompts (synthetic fuzz tests showed >5% drop on our embedding similarity threshold). They have asked for a manual/bespoke calibration pass (stratified sampling + targeted outlier analysis) and an explicit accuracy report comparing float32 -> FP8 and INT8 fallback profiles.

Goals:
- Produce a customer-specific FP8 calibration profile with documented calibration samples and thresholds.
- Validate accuracy against a curated test corpus and human-annotated reference set.
- Produce a signed-off regression report and recommended rollout strategy (full enable / model-variant routing / flip to int8).
- Deliver artifacts (calibration profile, evaluation notebook, metrics dashboards, and rollout config) to support the customer's deployment window.
acceptance_criteria: Calibration profile generated and checked into runtime-artifacts S3 with manifest and metadata
Evaluation harness run: quantitative metrics (embedding cosine, token-level perplexity, task-specific EM) for float32 vs FP8 vs INT8 present
Human review: 3 SMEs sign off on no-high-severity semantic regressions for sample of 200 prompts
Rollout recommendation documented and approved by PM and Support
steps: 1) Collect customer canonical prompt set (get secure link from Support).
2) Stratify the prompt set into 3 buckets: low-complexity, long-context, domain-specific edge cases.
3) Run calibration harness on dedicated A100-80GB node: per-layer scale collection with dynamic-range logging.
4) Produce quantization profile and run litmus evaluation (100k tokens sampled) comparing float32, FP8, and INT8.
5) Run human-in-the-loop review on 200 flagged samples using internal eval UI.
6) Create PR with profile + runtime config and run staging rollout to a canary capacity tier.
7) Prepare final report and schedule customer handoff meeting.
